anchors.title: Bendigo Art Gallery
anchors.description: One of Australia's oldest and largest regional galleries, known for its blockbuster international fashion exhibitions. Houses 5,000+ works from colonial to contemporary.

anchors.title: Central Deborah Gold Mine
anchors.description: Take the lift 61 metres underground into a real 19th-century gold mine. Hard-hat tour with working stamper batteries and a 'Mine Experience' that lets you drill rock.

anchors.title: Bendigo Tramways Vintage Tour
anchors.description: Climb aboard a heritage tram for an hour-long, hop-on hop-off tour of Bendigo's grand boulevards. Audio commentary tells the story of the gold-rush wealth that built the city.

anchors.title: Golden Dragon Museum
anchors.description: Tells the story of Bendigo's enduring Chinese community since the 1850s gold rush. Home to Sun Loong — at 100m long, one of the world's longest imperial dragons.

anchors.title: Rosalind Park & Poppet Head Lookout
anchors.description: Heritage-listed parklands beside the City Hall. Climb the restored 1876 Poppet Head mining frame for the city's best lookout, with views across the cathedral and Pall Mall.

SATURDAY.title: Bendigo Community Farmers Market
SATURDAY.description: Second Saturday of each month, 9am-1pm at Rosalind Park. 50+ local growers from across the central Victorian gold-country.
